test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution: The correct answer is "harmless." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "harmless" means not able or not likely to cause damage or injury; safe. (अहानिकर; सुरक्षित) • The word **"harmless"** is suitable for the blank in the sentence. • Example:* You needn’t be frightened—these insects are completely **harmless**__.* • In this context, **"harmless"** is used to describe moths as not causing harm or posing a threat. • The sentence contrasts the fear of unpleasant and potentially harmful insects with the fact that moths, despite being insects, are perceived as harmless. • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer. • Correct paragraph: We __have been__ brought up to fear insects. We regard them as unnecessary creatures that do more harm than good. Man continually __wages__ war on them, because they contaminate his food, carry diseases, or devour his crops. They sting or bite without provocation; they fly uninvited into our rooms on summer nights or beat against our lighted windows. We live in dread not only of unpleasant insects like spiders or wasps but of quite __**harmless**__ ones like moths. Reading about them increases our understanding without dispelling our fears.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Benignant: **kindly and benevolent. (दयालु और परोपकारी) • **Wholesome: **good for your health. (शारीरिक स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य के लिए हितकर, स्‍वास्‍थ्‍यवर्धक, पुष्टिकर, पौष्टिक) • **Nonfatal: **not causing death. (अघातक) 1f4:Tb8f, The correct answer is "Most."
